'''Bossy McBossface''' is a miniboss in [[The Shadow Reef]]. He can be found along with many [[Zombie (The Shadow Reef)|zombies]] in the first stage. Throughout the fight, he will periodically spawn up to three waves of [[summoned skeleton|skeletons]] to help fight for him. His [[Bossy McBossFace's First mate|first mate]] can spawn on any of the waves, but this is not always guaranteed. Bossy McBossface counts as a zombie for slayer tasks, as do the nearby zombies.

==Trivia==
* The boss's name was chosen by the winner of a [[Gameblast 2018]] charity auction.
* The boss's name is a reference to {{WP|RRS Sir David Attenborough#Naming poll|Boaty McBoatface}}, a research ship which was named by public poll.
* His model is based on the updated version of the [[Black Knight Titan]].
* He is voiced by [[Mod Debris]].
